integrity: The kernel coefficient formula is reconstructed directly from the Gram definition and the classical upper-half-plane Bergman kernel. The auxiliary factor is quadratic, its roots are solved exactly, and the map from kernel pairs to the reciprocal difference parameter is proved onto the lower half-plane. The lead primary full text and the closest earlier xi-Bergman frameworks were inspected at the relevant theorem or abstract level; targeted publication searches found no equivalent two-coefficient phase classification.
scientific_limitations: The classification is restricted to nonzero sequences supported in the value-and-first-derivative indices {0,1}. It concerns the canonical Gram kernel itself and does not require an additional diagonal-identification convention for arbitrary complex sequences. Higher finite support is not classified.
title: Exact two-jet Lu Qi-Keng phase for the canonical ξ-Bergman Gram kernel
